signal_row_verdict: A twin/signals.yaml row binds a pinned feed version to a SCENARIO id. The signal-classify corpus needs {steep, component}: a STEEP tag and exactly one component binding. A row carries no STEEP tag at all, and it reaches components only through the scenario, which names several. So a bound row is a real, merged, human-reviewed label for a question none of the six skills asks, and deriving a STEEP tag from it here would be this builder authoring the label -- the one thing ticket 03 forbids.

evidence.statement: Calibrated expert judgement, recorded as judgement (twin evidence ladder rung 4), by the role accountable for how this model positions things. The niobium refining-capacity headline says a single-country bottleneck in qubit/SRF-grade refining is tightening; this overlay carries that headline as its own standing scenario `niobium-supply-shock-2026` rather than as a feed entry (ecosystem ticket 23 item 1), so what moves here is the position, not a signal binding. What this claim asserts: that the derived midpoint 0.625 overstates how substitutable a tier-one supplier relationship is for this company. What it does NOT assert: any magnitude, any date, and any causal path from the headline to the coordinate -- there is no edge between the two intel rows the headline names (`nb-refining-capacity` and `pq-cryptanalysis` both name the same `links_risk`, a FAIR risk id, and neither is a component of any twin model), and no edge of any type moves a coordinate anyway (ecosystem ticket 51). And what this claim MOVES today is nothing: no code path in this estate reads a committed override to move a coordinate at any evidence grade, so the map and the feed render identically with and without this file. That is not the rung-4 use gate working -- the same claim at grade 1 renders the same bytes; it is that the operation the ruling describes has no implementation yet. At rung 4 this prices nothing on its own either: only rungs 1-2 carry an interventional delta into a scored forecast (twin decision ticket 08 Q2). It is scoreable only through the proposition of a scenario that names this component -- `a-tier-one-supplier-fails-to-deliver-within-the-horizon`, resolving 2027-08-28 -- and never on the coordinate itself, which has no published answer key and lives on an ordinal axis. Its pre-registration date is the day this file's CONTENT last reaches driftwood's `origin/main` (`twin/registration.py`), not the date written above: rewrite the number after it lands and it re-registers on the day of the rewrite.
